newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks sink 2.62 pct as blue chips drop.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks sink 2.62 pct as blue chips drop.

text.p: Pakistani stocks sagged 2.62 percent at Wednesday's close as blue chips tumbled on heavy selling fuelled by a grim economic outlook, dealers said.

"Investors' morale is down because of Pakistan's weak economic indicators," dealer Mohammad Iqbal said. "All those stocks that had gained in pre- and post-election rallies have taken heavy beatings," he said.
"The energy sector, including Hub Power, weakened after the statement by a federal minister last week that government plans to revise tariffs for power purchase from private companies."
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share fell 26.63 points to end at 1,543.18. Losers beat gainers 250 to 45 as turnover rose to 50.72 million shares from 42.52 on Tuesday.
Hub Power fell 0.80 to 37.20 rupees, PTCL 1.20 to 28.25 and ICI Pakistan 1.20 to 21.95.
